features.title: No Service? No Problem
features.description: Works via WiFi, Bluetooth mesh, and satellite fallback when traditional carriers fail.
features.details: Mod Cellular automatically scans for available connections and routes messages through the best available path. Dead zones don't exist in our network.

features.title: Earn While You Connect
features.description: Get MODX tokens for relaying messages. Your phone becomes infrastructure.
features.details: Relay mining rewards range from 0.01 to 0.05 MODX per action based on contribution type. Top relayers earn $50-500/month.

features.title: Privacy First
features.description: End-to-end encryption with no carrier surveillance. Your messages stay yours.
features.details: Signal Protocol-inspired encryption ensures only sender and recipient can read messages. No metadata collection, no government backdoors.

features.title: Always On
features.description: Offline queue, DTN routing, and emergency broadcast ensure delivery.
features.details: Messages stay in DTN (Delay-Tolerant Networking) queue for up to 7 days, delivering when connection returns. Emergency SOS broadcasts at priority 999.

features.title: Zero Setup
features.description: Auto-wallet, auto-scanning, plug-and-play. Download and go.
features.details: Wallet created on first launch. Signal scanning starts automatically. No configuration, no technical knowledge required.

features.title: Global Network
features.description: Same app works worldwide. No roaming fees, no SIM swaps.
features.details: Mesh network spans 127 countries. Connect to local WiFi or nearby peers anywhere on Earth. True global connectivity.

cta_after_features.subtext: No credit card. No commitment. Just your email.
